set.name: Ibiden Co., Ltd.
set.description: Japan-based leading IC substrate manufacturer. Market leader in advanced ABF (Ajinomoto Build-up Film) substrates for AI accelerators and high-performance computing. Operates multiple fabs in Japan (Ono, Kawama) with aggressive capacity expansion through 2027. Primary supplier to TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging.

append_metrics.name: Global IC substrate market share
append_metrics.description: Ibiden holds approximately 22% global IC substrate revenue share as of 2025, per TrendForce semiconductor substrate market analysis. Leadership in premium ABF-class substrates for AI compute.

append_metrics.name: ABF substrate supply concentration
append_metrics.description: Ibiden estimated at 40% of high-end ABF substrate supply for AI accelerators (2025-2026), based on DigiTimes analysis of TSMC CoWoS supply chain and 2021-2023 shortage episodes.

append_metrics.name: Substrate capacity expansion (Ono + Kawama)
append_metrics.description: Ibiden's Ono fab expansion and Kawama new facility ramping to full capacity by Q3 2027; expansion lead time 18 months from current state, per company earnings disclosures.

node_patches.append_notes: Critical supplier for AI accelerator substrate demand. 2021-2023 ABF shortage episodes directly constrained TSMC, Samsung, ASE advanced packaging capacity; Ibiden was named in multiple DigiTimes/Nikkei shortage reports as supply gating. Investor relevance: strong exposure to AI infrastructure buildout and HPC market growth.

append_metrics.name: Advanced packaging capacity (CoWoS-type)
append_metrics.description: ASE's estimated advanced 2.5D/3D packaging capacity in 2025-2026, including CoWoS-equivalent and proprietary integration services, per DigiTimes supply-chain reporting.

node_patches.append_notes: ASE is a secondary 2.5D/3D packaging source alongside TSMC CoWoS, with expanding capacity to capture overflow demand from AI accelerator modules. Ticker corrected to 3711.TW (post-merger ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. holdco).

append_metrics.name: Advanced packaging market position (I-Cube/SAINT)
append_metrics.description: Samsung Electronics' 2.5D/3D packaging (I-Cube and SAINT classes) ranks as secondary source to TSMC CoWoS in advanced AI accelerator packaging, with ~15-20% estimated market share in premium segments (2025-2026).

append_metrics.name: Advanced packaging capacity expansion
append_metrics.description: Samsung's advanced packaging capacity expansion through new Lines X and Y facilities expected to reach full production in ~16 months from current state, per company investor relations and DigiTimes reporting.

node_patches.append_notes: Samsung Electronics' Semiconductor Business Division offers I-Cube and SAINT-class 2.5D/3D packaging as alternative to TSMC CoWoS. Strategic second source for AI accelerator modules in diversification strategies. Investor relevance: foundry capacity and advanced packaging revenues both beneficiary of AI infrastructure growth.

edge_patches.claim: Samsung Electronics offers I-Cube and SAINT-class 2.5D/3D advanced packaging as a secondary source to TSMC CoWoS for AI accelerator modules, with ~15-20% estimated share in premium advanced packaging segments.
